subject: Saffron status: replication green, honest limits
body:
Hi Jelena,

Saffron status. Replication is green: our internal models complete PCFG-generated sequences and a meaningful slice of ARC-style ASCII patterns in-context, and — the result that keeps surprising people — proficiency is partially retained when we remap sequences onto randomly sampled tokens from the vocabulary.

Robotics-format evals: state-sequence extrapolation produces usable simple motions, and with least-to-most prompting of reward-conditioned trajectories we get a stabilizing CartPole controller in-context after roughly 50 episodes of context.

The honest risks, same ones the paper flags: latency (seconds per action), context limits (50 episodes barely fits), and token cost. This is a prototyping tool, not a control stack.

Yusuf
